svg.text: 認可證券市場 (recognized stock market)指《證券及期貨條例》
附表1第1部第1條所界定的證券市場；
recognized stock market (認可證券市場) means a stock market as defined by section 1 of Part 1 of
Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571).
“《證券及期貨條例》(第571章)附表1第1部第1條所界定的證券市場；” — replace “》” with “)”.
Source: DATA.GOV.HK dataset hk-doj-hkel-legislation-current (last modified 24 Nov 2026),
downloaded 25 Nov 2026. Rendered verbatim from the official XML (Temporal_ID s84_1). HKeL is
updated continuously; the live text may since have changed.
